children: QVC Group filed an unaudited post-confirmation report for the period ended September 30, 2026, reporting no cash disbursements or other transfers.
The report covers August 6 through September 30, 2026, after QVC Group emerged from Chapter 11 on August 6.
The report lists $0 in cash disbursements and $0 in non-cash securities or other property transferred, both for the quarter and since the plan’s effective date.
QVC Group says the report was prepared to meet Bankruptcy Code requirements and was not audited or reviewed by independent accountants.
The company cautions that the report is preliminary, may be revised, and should not be relied upon to assess current or future financial condition or performance.
